items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: got Milt to caption them so they knew who they were... I said to Milt, 'do you mean to say the photograph comes to life?'... What made me decide to do the movie was him telling me about this home movie that she’d taken.

ctx.x: Yes he did the books. He’s the one that went down in that basement, which must be like Fibber McGee’s closet, and found a lot of wonderful photographs and got Milt to caption them so they knew who they were, and so I said to him, he teaches sociology in Philadelphia. I said, “get two of your Phi Beta students and go down there and look at every piece of celluloid you can find.” And they finally found the film.
How much actual footage was it? Time-wise?
